speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Slower. The same two sheets. In shape no bigger then an Agot stone, on the forefinger of an Alderman.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: I have the first. Keep the measure. I am not stopping you.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The hazel-nut coach. Lawyers' fingers. Soldiers' necks. I am through the tenth line before the pig.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: His mouth is moving and no sound is coming out of it. That is a part, or it is a grace before meat. I will not choose.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Leave it. I am fitting the line to the teeth. Read.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The parson's tithe-pig. Slower than the last time. The same pig.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: I stopped once. I will not make a rite of the second. The pig is noted.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: And what do I say, while he says all that?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thou say'st 'Peace.' Once.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: It's enough.

speaker: agnes_tipping
text: An alderman! You'll have us shut.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The alderman is a finger, Agnes. Not a guest. Not a warrant.

speaker: agnes_tipping
text: A finger with a title is how a complaint starts. I have said it. The sixpence still stands.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: I can speak it. The tenth line sat in the mouth on that pass. I do not need a third reading.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Peace, once, and then he runs. I will not add a sentence to a word that has been measured.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: I remember that there was a message. I do not remember the words. He will have to send it again.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Then he can be angry on his own time. The pig is the only interruption I am willing to own.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two sheets since Saturday. What you heard is what they say. The rest of the paper is notes, and notes are not lines.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: I will speak the lines. I will not speak the notes. Again was the once. I am not asking a third.

speaker: agnes_tipping
text: Good. Finish the plates. An alderman on a finger I can survive. An alderman in the room I will not.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Enough is the word I was given. I have said it. The afternoon is the king, and this is not the king.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am in the king this afternoon, and this speech is not his. The sheets go home with me. They are not leaving in a sleeve that is not mine.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Take them. Sixpence was the dear part. The mutton was the small part. I have chewed through both.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: I will go back and say I forgot. That is a true sentence, if it is not the one I was given.

speaker: agnes_tipping
text: Out, when the plates are clear. This is an ordinary. The alderman is not staying for a second cup.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Clear, then. Peace, once. The size of her, on the sheet, is the two lines at the top.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Two lines at the top, and the rest as you read it. I have them apart in my ear.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Then we are done with her. The king can have the afternoon without this speech in his mouth.
